Context: 1. Appeal

1. An appeal is one which is preferred to the appropriate Appellate Authority against an order of penalty. Right of appeal has been provided in certain other cases also, like, (i) suspension, (ii) payment of subsistence allowance during suspension, (iii) regulation of pay and allowances for period of suspension and/or unemployment, on reinstatement and (iv) withholding/withdrawing pension or part thereof, by an order of the Appointing Authority, when a pensioner is found guilty of grave misconduct or is
